'''Self-aware toys''' were played with by [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] when they were children. The toys would try to run away from their grasping hands, and could be recharged by a [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]].
